regime_decision.rule: preregistered: best id_clean, ties (<2 pts) -> fewer changed knobs; C2 93.14 vs C1 91.83 is a tie, C1 changes one knob

design.controller: unchanged (delta_target 0.778, kp 1, ki 0.02, alpha 0.05, integral_max 1, return_floor 8)

evaluation.primary: dr_full success at each budget; co-primary id_clean

hypotheses.H_R1_lossless_base: off@32 under the regime holds id_clean >= 90 (fine-tuning no longer destroys the policy)
hypotheses.H_R2_robustness_gain: at least one DR arm exceeds off on dr_full by > 3 pts at 32 it while holding id_clean within 3 pts of off — a genuine robustness gain, not degradation-rate
hypotheses.H_R3_anchor_vs_fixed: ta_lucid_50 id_clean >= fixed + 3 pts with dr_full >= fixed - 2 pts at 32 it
hypotheses.H_R4_horizon: at 128 it, fixed id_clean degrades > 5 pts from its 32-it value while ta_lucid_50 degrades < 3 pts (latency at full strength is still destabilizing; the anchor + gating retain)
hypotheses.H_R5_beat_release: any arm reaching dr_full > 69.61 with id_clean >= 95 — the paper-grade capability bar; not expected at 32 it

decision_rules.no_post_hoc: no combining C1+C2 in this stage; a combined regime needs its own preregistration
